comments.comment: overlapsChange gained a branch for locations at the base, and no test passes a location with revision "base", so any mistake in that branch passes the suite.
comments.failureScenario: Every test in test/overlap.test.ts passes a location without revision, so none reaches the base branch. If it read hunk.newStart and hunk.newLines instead of the old ones, a base location on deleted line 12 of the edit hunk would no longer count, and a finding the deletion caused would read as unrelated, yet all three tests would still pass.
